name: Amsterdam
about: Tulip season (April) and summer are magical but busy, winter is grey, wet and quiet.
overview: Canal-ring architecture, world-class museums, and a bike-first culture packed into one compact, walkable city.
costOverview: Everyday extras like a bike rental or a stroopwafel are cheap, but museums, the canal cruise, and dinner out add up fast.

specialSeasons.text: Tulip season is in full bloom across the countryside and at Keukenhof gardens.
